items.q: What is the simplified acquisition threshold?
Who approves a J&A at or below $900,000?
Who approves a J&A above $900,000 up to $20M, and is it delegable?
items.a: The advocate for competition. Not delegable.

items.q: What document appoints a contracting officer, and what must it state?
items.a: An SF 1402, Certificate of Appointment, stating any limitations on the CO's scope of authority.

cite.quote: Contracting officers must be appointed in writing, using a Standard Form (SF) 1402, Certificate of Appointment.

items.q: Who may sign, administer, or terminate contracts for the Government?
items.a: Only contracting officers, within delegated authority.

cite.quote: Only contracting officers may sign, administer, or terminate contracts on behalf of the Government.
